claim: False-negative discovery seeds known public-incident hazard analogues (destructive drops, unscoped DML, NOT NULL without default, column renames, non-concurrent index builds) into a real migration layout, runs Patchline's static baseline, and measures recall so the hazards Patchline under-escalates or misses are surfaced explicitly instead of hidden.

hazards.incident_analogue: destructive column drop without backfill (data-loss class)
hazards.sql: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;

hazards.incident_analogue: unscoped DELETE wiping a table (backfill-gone-wrong class)
ADD/SET NOT NULL without default on a large table (write-blocking rewrite)
hazards.sql: ALTER TABLE accounts ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL;

hazards.incident_analogue: column rename breaking deployed readers (multi-step expand/contract violation)
hazards.sql: ALTER TABLE accounts RENAME COLUMN name TO full_name;

hazards.incident_analogue: non-concurrent index build taking a write lock on a hot table

benign_control.sql: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN note text;
